# NSPanel HAUI 0.5.5

0.5.5 makes a display install safe from the hub itself. Once a panel accepted a TFT upload it stops answering the hub, and the page-acknowledge timeout used to redraw the whole panel into that transfer — the likely reason a panel could end up refusing every later upload. The hub now holds every display command until the install ends.

The rest of the release is the release process itself: `master` is the only long-lived branch, a release is a merged pull request plus a tag, and a development build carries its version in the image instead of committing it.

This release updates the integration and the firmware. Both TFTs are unchanged, so display version 0.4.5 remains required.

## Before updating

**Nothing to change in your configuration.** There is no TFT update, no renamed entity, no changed service and no migration.

Install the firmware that ships with this version: the display guard lives in the integration, but the firmware is what keeps a page update from being written into an upload in the first place.

If you follow the **Development** channel, a dev build no longer changes the integration's installed version — it carries `X.Y.Z.devN` inside the image and uses it as the release tag, so the integration stays on the last stable release while firmware and display still update. Switch the panel back to **Stable** if you want the integration to move with the releases again.

## Changed

- **One branch, one tag** — `master` is the only long-lived branch and no workflow pushes to it. A release is a pull request that the ruleset gates plus a `vX.Y.Z` tag, so there is no sync step and nothing to reconcile after a release ([Release process](docs/develop/release.md)).
- **Development builds version the firmware only** — a dev image reports its own `X.Y.Z.devN` through the build instead of writing it into `manifest.json`, which keeps the released version. A panel on the **Development** channel updates firmware and display; the integration stays stable until you update it yourself ([Release process](docs/develop/release.md#published-development-firmware)).

## Fixed

- **The hub no longer writes into its own TFT upload** — a display stops acknowledging page changes once it accepts an upload, so the 10-second page-ack timeout fired mid-transfer and re-sent `goto_page` plus a full panel render, some hundred commands, into the upload. A transfer interrupted that way is what leaves a display refusing later uploads. Every display command is now held until the install ends, and the page is drawn again when the panel reconnects ([Troubleshooting](docs/user/troubleshooting.md#the-panel-refuses-every-tft-upload)).
